offline_search_j.conclusion: Higher-OOF extension found at 58% C1 (J3), but the public response curve is near its optimum around 45-50% C1; J1 remains the public-fit-first backup, J3 the higher-OOF hedge, and J2 the diversity hedge.
offline_search_j.decision_rule: Require positive OOF delta vs I1 and non-negative date-3 delta vs I1; do not submit until budget resets.
